title: Debug: the always-expensive shipment
prompt: Every customer is charged 12. The intended tiers: prime → 0, items >= 10 → 5, items >= 3 → 8, else 12. Find and fix the condition bugs (order and boundary) in `shippingCost`.

tests.name: all tiers correct
tests.hint: Prime check must come FIRST (bulk prime is free, not 5); volume boundaries stay >=.
